proposals.risk: provider-controlled text survives into the public failure message
proposals.rationale: An SDK failure without a status code keeps the provider's text, to make such failures debuggable.
proposals.replacement:
def __post_init__(self) -> None:
    """Discard provider-controlled text before the failure can become observable."""
    safe_message = (
        f"Provider request failed with status code {self.status_code}."
        if self.status_code is not None
        else f"Provider request failed: {self.message}"
    )
    object.__setattr__(self, "message", safe_message)
